SEIZURE MEMORANDUM

Case: FIR No. 47/2026
Date: 14 August 2026
Place: Senapati Road junction, Pune
Vehicle seized: MH-12-AB-4821
Driver/person from whom vehicle was taken into custody: Rohan Mehta
Items noted with the vehicle: front registration plate, vehicle keys, and damaged front bumper assembly.

The seizure was documented in the presence of panch witnesses and the articles were taken into police custody for investigation.
